name: plan
description: Systematic planning for medium-to-large tasks. Gathers context, identifies domain skills, writes phased plans to brain/plans/. Does NOT implement. Use for new features, multi-file refactors, or architectural changes — not small fixes. Triggers: "plan this", "break this down".

findings.excerpt: noodle event emit --session $NOODLE_SESSION_ID stage_yield --payload '{"message": "Plan written to brain/plans/NN-slug-name/overview.md"}'
